purpose: Canonical source registry for parking dynamics research.

parking_meters.role: physical parking-space inventory and canonical PARKING_SPACE_ID/POST_ID/BLOCKFACE_ID mapping

meter_policies.role: time-varying operating hours, rates and time limits

sfpark_sensor_hourly.role: historical physical occupancy ground truth / calibration target

notes: The historical sensor CSV is large; import it from a local file with the dedicated importer rather than downloading it into git.
The current public SFpark availability API is documented historically by SFMTA; this branch does not assume the legacy endpoint remains live.
All model features must obey forecast-as-of timestamps; no future sensor/session/policy data may be used.
PARKING_SPACE_ID is the canonical physical-space join key in the current Parking Meters dataset.
